snippet.title: Those Who Dwell | Official Teaser Trailer | Folk Horror Indie Game
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3762690/Those_Who_Dwell/

Those Who Dwell is a story-first psychological horror focused on isolation, atmosphere, and folklore. Light is your only hope as you explore deeper into a cursed cave system disturbed by those who dug too deep. Restore shrines, survive the dark, and uncover what became of Those Who Dwell.
